slides.heading: Cut list
slides.note: 1×12: 24" of 48". 1×4: 5 slats from 8 ft, 2 from 6 ft.

slides.heading: Build it
items: Handholds: two 1" holes 3½" apart, 2" from the top of each end. Jigsaw between.
Glue and screw 2 side slats per side: one flush at the top, one at the bottom.
Screw the 3 bottom slats to the ends, evenly spaced.
Pre-drill every hole. Sand to 150 grit.
slides.tip: Clamp the end before drilling or cutting. Keep fingers clear of the jigsaw blade.
